record.reason: MeanCache reuses average flow velocity to skip redundant flow-matching computations and reports 3.42x–4.12x acceleration while preserving video/image quality. It is generative diffusion, not LLM inference, but caching/step-skipping is a potentially transferable adjacent optimization.
record.title: MeanCache: From Instantaneous to Average Velocity for Accelerating Flow Matching Inference
